questions: Is the count bugged?
The army number is wrong, is that a bug?
Why do the numbers never match exactly?
answers.answer: Not a bug. Olympus has no central server: your addon adds up the guild reports it heard itself, and each guild sends one every few minutes. Players who logged in at different times hold slightly different reports, so their numbers are a bit apart.
answers.in_game: Not a bug: there's no central server. Your addon adds up the guild reports it heard, so players who logged in at different times see slightly different numbers.
answers.notes: L.HEADER_TIP_DIFFER says everyone converges within minutes: only true for online counts and for guilds with an addon user online.

questions: Why is my count different from my friend's?
My guildmate sees 500 more soldiers than I do
We checked at the same time and got different totals
answers.answer: Your addon counts what it heard since you logged in. When everyone with the addon in a guild logs off, that guild's size keeps counting for 24h on clients that heard it, but someone who logs in later never hears it. So whoever's been on longer usually sees more.
answers.in_game: Your addon counts what it heard since login. A guild whose addon users logged off still counts for 24h on clients that heard it, so whoever's been on longer usually sees more.
sources: Comm.lua:1094-1223 (only a guild's own reporters answer the login ask)

questions: My guild shows 180 online for me but 172 for my friend in another guild
Why is my guild's number different on other people's screens?
answers.answer: Your own guild comes live from your guild roster. Everyone else sees it from its last report, sent every ~3 minutes, so its online number is always a little behind on their screens.
answers.in_game: Your own guild is live from your roster. Others see it from its last report (every ~3 min), so online is a bit behind on their screens.

questions: Why is another guild's number different from what its members see?
Their guild says 180 online but I see 172
answers.answer: Another guild's numbers are its last report, sent every ~3 minutes by one of its members with the addon. Its own members see it live from their roster, so on your screen it trails a little. Free slots are 1000 less that report's size.
answers.in_game: Another guild's numbers are its last report, sent every ~3 min, so they trail what its own members see live. Free slots come from that report too.
sources: Data.lua:358-383 (a row is the last accepted report)

questions: Why does the count keep changing?
The total just jumped by 300
Why did online suddenly drop?
answers.answer: It moves as reports come in, about every 3 minutes per guild. A guild with no report for 15 minutes turns grey and its online players stop counting; after 24h its size leaves the total too. Big jumps are usually a whole guild arriving or aging out.
answers.in_game: It moves as guild reports arrive (~every 3 min). After 15 min without one a guild goes grey and its online stops counting; after 24h its size goes too.

questions: My count dropped after I relogged
It shows almost no guilds after /reload
Is the army gone? The window is empty
answers.answer: The beta often forgets addon data at login, so your census rebuilds from what it hears, in about 3 minutes. No /reload needed. Guilds where nobody with the addon is online come back when someone there with the addon logs in.
answers.in_game: The beta often forgets addon data at login, so the census rebuilds in about 3 min. No /reload needed. Guilds with no addon user online come back when one logs in.
answers.notes: Whether the live (non-beta) Forever client loads saved variables is unconfirmed; drop 'The beta often forgets' if it does.
sources: Comm.lua:996-1005,1051-1066 (only addon users are elected to report)

questions: The Realm tab says Online now (12) but my guild has 19 online
Why is Olympus's online list shorter than my guild roster?
answers.answer: The Lord and Captains are listed above that line, so they're not in its number. Add the ones who are online and it matches your roster.
answers.in_game: The Lord and Captains are listed above that line, so they're not in its number. Add the online ones and it matches your roster.
sources: Views.lua:1078-1087 MembersOf skips leader and officers

questions: Why doesn't it match Blizzard's /who?
/who shows 50 but Olympus says 212 online
The guild window says something different
answers.answer: /who lists 50 players per search, so it can't show a big guild's full count. Olympus uses each guild's own roster, sent by a member with the addon. Your own guild matches your guild window; other guilds are a report a few minutes old.
answers.in_game: The /who list stops at 50 per search. Olympus uses each guild's own roster instead. Yours matches your guild window; other guilds are a report a few minutes old.
answers.notes: Unchecked: Classic Era/Anniversary with the old Guild window's 'Show Offline Members' unticked.

questions: The Realm shows 50 online for another guild but the Census says 212
Why does 'Seen online' stop at 50?
answers.answer: For other guilds, the Realm tab lists who /who found. /who gives 50 per search, and the Lord and Captains are listed above that line. More clicks dig further, level by level. The Census number is that guild's own report, so go by that one.
answers.in_game: Seen online is what /who found (50 per search, more clicks dig further), minus the Lord and Captains. The Census number is the guild's own report: go by that one.
answers.notes: L.MEMBERS_SEEN_TIP says reports only name the Lord and Captains; they also carry each guild's top five.

questions: Olympus is way bigger than this, why so low?
My friend's guild isn't counted
answers.answer: Only guilds where someone runs the addon get counted. Guilds found only with /who show in grey and count in no total. One member with the addon online puts their whole guild in, so the more installs, the fuller the census.
answers.in_game: Only guilds where someone runs the addon count. One member with the addon puts their whole guild in, so tell your guild to install it.

questions: The Online column adds up to more than the header
The Members column doesn't match the soldiers total
Total soldiers is lower than all the guilds together
answers.answer: Grey rows stay listed but stop counting: their online players after 15 minutes without a report, their size after 24h. Linked alts also count once in the header. So the columns can add up to more than the header.
answers.in_game: Grey rows stay listed but stop counting: online after 15 min without a report, size after 24h. Linked alts count once too.

questions: It says 45 guilds but only 30 have numbers
Why does the guild count include grey ones?
answers.answer: The guild count includes grey guilds, which stay listed for 7 days after their last report; their numbers just stop counting once the report gets too old. Rows with ? for members were only seen with /who and aren't in that count.
answers.in_game: It counts grey guilds too (listed 7 days after their last report). Rows with ? for members were only seen with /who and aren't in it.

questions: My friend sees guilds I don't
A big guild is grey for me but not for them
Our guild is missing for everyone else
answers.answer: If that guild has addon users online and it still doesn't show for you after a few minutes, check your channel key. If your guild's key differs from the others' (or you're public while they sealed theirs), you hear a different set of guilds. Ask an officer for the key.
answers.in_game: If the guild has people online and still doesn't show after a few minutes, check your channel key: a different key (or none) hears other guilds. Ask an officer.
answers.notes: The usual reason is login time (count-differs-from-friend): the key only explains it while that guild has an addon user online. L.SEEN_TIP tells these players 'nobody in this guild runs the addon', which is wrong in this case.

questions: My alt on another realm sees different numbers
Why can't the Horde see our guilds?
answers.answer: Each faction has its own census, and so does each realm group (PvP and PvP 2 share one). An alt on another realm or faction sees that census, not yours. The header says which census you're looking at.
answers.in_game: Each faction and realm group has its own census (PvP and PvP 2 share one). The header says which one you're seeing.
answers.notes: The per-realm channel is read from code comments, not confirmed in game.

questions: What do the grey rows mean?
Why is a guild grey?
answers.answer: Grey means no fresh report from that guild in the last 15 minutes, or it was only spotted with /who. Its online players don't count. A guild that did report keeps its size in the total for a day.
answers.in_game: Grey = no fresh report in 15 min (or only seen with /who). Its online doesn't count; a reported guild's size still counts for a day.

questions: The map shows fewer soldiers than are online
Zone totals don't add up
answers.answer: Zones only count guilds where the player sending the numbers shares their location. Everyone else still counts in the total, just not in any zone, so the map adds up to less than online.
answers.in_game: Zones only count guilds whose sender shares their location. Everyone else still counts in the total, just in no zone.

questions: Only ~5 with Olympus on my layer?
The layer count is way too low
answers.answer: That's a sample, not a headcount: only players who share their location announce their layer, and of those just Lords, Captains and about 1 in 8 others. There are a lot more of us on it.
answers.in_game: That's a sample: only players who share their location announce their layer, and of those just Lords, Captains and about 1 in 8 others.
answers.notes: No tooltip explains this today (Views.lua:1758 only says Experimental).

questions: Can an old version count differently?
My friend is on an older version, is that why?
answers.answer: Yes. Older versions miss things newer ones handle, like approved guilds, hidden guilds and linked alts, so their totals drift. Update in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then restart the game.
answers.in_game: Yes: older versions miss things like approved guilds, hidden guilds and linked alts. Update in CurseForge or WowUp and restart the game.

questions: The donor count looks too high
Why is the ranking lower than on the Treasurer's screen?
answers.answer: The week's donors are counted per keeper, so someone who gave to two keepers counts in both. And on everyone's screen but the Treasurer's, the ranking leaves out what may be dues, so it reads lower there.
answers.in_game: Donors are counted per keeper, so giving to two counts twice. The ranking leaves out what may be dues, so it's lower than on the Treasurer's screen.

questions: Why does the roll call say someone is silent when they logged off?
What does +N unconfirmed mean on the Throne?
answers.answer: Silent means a Lord or Captain the latest report showed online didn't answer, and that report can be a few minutes old, so someone who just logged off counts. Unconfirmed answers came from players the census can't place yet.
answers.in_game: Silent = shown online by the latest report (a few min old) but no answer, so someone who just logged off counts. Unconfirmed: the census can't place them yet.

questions: Who can use Olympus?
Why does it say my guild isn't an Olympus guild?
Does it work outside Olympus?
answers.answer: Guilds with Olympus in the name (misspellings count, anti-Olympus names don't), plus guilds on the author's approved list, like <OLYMPIAN> and <OLYMPIANS> on the Alliance. /oly approved shows the list. Anyone else gets the Join Olympus screen.
answers.in_game: Guilds with Olympus in the name, plus approved ones like <OLYMPIAN> and <OLYMPIANS> (/oly approved). Anyone else gets the Join Olympus screen.
answers.notes: Olympian, Olympia and Olympic are left out by the name rule on purpose; <OLYMPIAN> works from 1.1 only, <OLYMPIANS> from 1.1.5.

questions: How do I join Olympus?
What's the Join Olympus screen?
answers.answer: Outside an Olympus guild, the addon finds members online and whispers one a ready-made request you can edit (Try someone else picks another if nobody replies). Where to go points you to the guild the King opened the gates for, or the one with the most room.
answers.in_game: Open /oly outside an Olympus guild: it finds members online and whispers one a request you can edit. Where to go shows who has room.

questions: A join request showed on top of my Census
What do Invite and Decline do there?
How do I stop recruits whispering me?
answers.answer: That's a recruit who asked you from the Join Olympus screen. Officers get Invite (the game's guild invite) and Decline (one polite whisper); anyone can Dismiss, which sends nothing. /oly nocontact on stops recruits' screens from picking you.
answers.in_game: A recruit asked you from the Join screen. Officers: Invite or Decline. Dismiss sends nothing. /oly nocontact on keeps recruits from picking you.

questions: What's the page with all the Yes/No questions?
Why does the privacy page show every login?
How do I change what I share?
answers.answer: It's the first-open page: Yes or No for each thing you can share, like location, layer help, chats and roll call, and each stays off until you say yes. The beta forgets addon data at login, so it may ask again each session. /oly privacy opens it anytime.
answers.in_game: That's the privacy page: each share stays off until you say yes. The beta forgets addon data, so it may ask each session. /oly privacy reopens it.

questions: What does the Census tab show?
What's in a guild's tooltip?
answers.answer: Every Olympus guild with its members, online and Lord; click a column to sort. Hover a guild for free slots, average level, inactive members, classes online and top zones.
answers.in_game: Every Olympus guild: members, online, Lord. Click a column to sort; hover a guild for free slots, level, classes and zones.

questions: What does 'N soldiers' mean?
What's the big number on top?
answers.answer: Soldiers is every counted guild's size added up, with linked alts once. Under it: how many are online, how many guilds, and how long ago the newest report came in. Hover it for how the count works.
answers.in_game: Soldiers = every counted guild's size added up. Under it: online, guilds, and when the newest report came in. Hover it for more.
answers.notes: The hover text (L.HEADER_TIP) says every addon user reports; only one elected member per guild and a runner-up do.

questions: Where is everyone?
How do I see soldiers per zone?
answers.answer: The Census shows the top zones and continent totals, counted from guilds whose sender shares their location. Type a zone in the Census search (say, Stormwind) for its soldiers and guilds.
answers.in_game: The Census lists top zones and continents. Search a zone (like Stormwind) for its soldiers and guilds.

questions: What's 'Rebuilding the census after login'?
Should I /reload when it's empty?
answers.answer: Right after login your addon rebuilds the census from what it hears. For about 3 minutes the header says how many guilds it's heard so far. The army isn't gone, and no /reload is needed.
answers.in_game: Your addon is refilling the census after login, about 3 minutes. The army isn't gone; no /reload needed.

questions: What's the 'Update Olympus' line?
It says a new version is out
answers.answer: The author's addon announces each release in game. If yours is older, you get a line at the bottom of the Census and one in chat. Update in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then restart the game.
answers.in_game: A newer Olympus is out. Update in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then restart the game.
answers.notes: Shows only after this client heard the author's presence with a /oly released mark.

questions: What's the warning mark next to a guild?
Why does a guild have a question mark?
answers.answer: A warning mark means players' reports for that guild disagree on its Lord, Captains or size; a question mark means only one player reports it. Hover it for details. It's a heads-up before a muster or the gates, and changes no count.
answers.in_game: Warning mark: reports for that guild disagree. Question mark: only one player reports it. Hover for details; it changes no count.

questions: How do I find a guild or a player?
Which guilds are recruiting?
answers.answer: Use the box on top of the Census: a guild, a Lord, a Captain, a player from a guild's top five or seen online, or a zone. Type recruiting (or free 50) for every guild with room, most free slots first and the King's gates on top.
answers.in_game: Search the Census box for a guild, Lord, Captain, zone or a player seen online. Type recruiting for every guild with room.

questions: What's 'Tonight on this client'?
Why is my peak different from my friend's?
answers.answer: The most soldiers your own addon saw online at once tonight, and when. It checks once a minute, starting about 3 minutes after login, so everyone's peak is their own, not an official figure.
answers.in_game: Your own addon's peak online tonight, checked once a minute. Everyone's is their own, not an official figure.

questions: Why do some guilds show in grey with a +?
What does Refresh do?
answers.answer: Grey rows with ? for members were found with /who, not by a report, so they count in no total. /who lists 50 per search, hence the +. Refresh re-reads your roster and searches /who a bit further with each click.
answers.in_game: Grey rows with ? for members were found by /who, not a report, and count in no total. /who stops at 50, hence the +. Refresh searches further.
answers.notes: Not in docs/CURSEFORGE.md (README.md:128-129 only).

questions: How do I share the census on Discord?
How do I copy the list?
answers.answer: Every tab has Copy for Discord: it opens a ready-to-paste text. Press Ctrl+C and paste it in Discord. It copies everything, even while a search is filtering the list.
answers.in_game: Press Copy for Discord on any tab, then Ctrl+C and paste it in Discord.

questions: What's the Realm tab?
Why is a Lord's name red?
answers.answer: The hierarchy: the King, the Treasurer, then every guild's Lord and Captains, online or how many days away. A name turns red after a long absence (3 days by default; /oly warndays changes it).
answers.in_game: The Realm tab is the hierarchy: King, Treasurer, Lords, Captains. Red names have been away 3+ days (/oly warndays to change).

questions: How do I see who's online in a guild?
Why does another guild's member list look short?
answers.answer: Open a guild in the Realm tab. Your own guild's list comes from your roster; other guilds' from /who, 50 per search (more clicks add more). Click a name to whisper, invite or /who them.
answers.in_game: Open a guild in the Realm tab: yours from your roster, others from /who (50 per search). Click a name to whisper or invite.

questions: What's the Level race?
Where do I see a guild's ranks?
answers.answer: Each guild in the Realm tab lists its ranks and how many hold them. The Level race ranks the realm's highest-level players, from each guild's top five.
answers.in_game: Each guild in the Realm lists its ranks. The Level race ranks the top players, from each guild's top five.

questions: How do I find inactive members?
Can the addon kick inactive people?
answers.answer: Type /oly inactive 7, 14 or 30 (or click your guild's inactive line in the Realm tab). If your rank can remove members, it's one person per click after a confirm. There's no kick-all, and nothing is sent.
answers.in_game: Type /oly inactive 7, 14 or 30 to list them. If your rank can remove members, it's one per click with a confirm. No kick-all.

questions: What's Recruits and their mentors?
How do I pair a recruit with a Captain?
answers.answer: For Lords: /oly recruits lists your new members. Click an online recruit, then a Captain, and say yes. Each gets one whisper: the Captain learns who to look after, the recruit who to ask.
answers.in_game: Lords: /oly recruits, click a recruit, then a Captain. Each gets one whisper so they know each other.

questions: What are centurions and correspondents?
How do I name a centurion?
Why does someone have a bronze border without wings?
answers.answer: Guild masters name up to 10 centurions and one correspondent per High Council department, members of their guild, in their Guild tab or with /oly nominees; the King and the High Council name the King's guild's 10 centurions on the Throne. They wear bronze without wings while in that guild.
answers.in_game: Guild masters: /oly nominees, or your Guild tab. Up to 10 centurions and one correspondent per council department, from your guild.

questions: Which guild should new players join?
What are the King's gates?
answers.answer: Recruiting on the Realm tab lists guilds with free slots, most first. When the King opens the gates of a guild, it goes on top for two hours: send new recruits there.
answers.in_game: Recruiting (Realm tab) lists guilds with room. When the King opens a guild's gates, it's on top for 2 hours: send recruits there.

questions: How do I get to the King's layer?
What does /oly hop do?
What's layer help?
answers.answer: While the King is online with his crown showing, go to his zone and click the Ask invite line (or /oly hop). Olympus players on his layer get asked to invite you, and you leave the group once you've moved. To help others hop: /oly location on and /oly layerhelp on.
answers.in_game: In the King's zone, click Ask invite (or /oly hop): players on his layer get asked to invite you. To help others: /oly location on and /oly layerhelp on.
answers.notes: Layer help does nothing without location sharing: Hop.CanHelp requires Layers.Sharing().

questions: How do I whisper a Lord from another guild?
What happens when I click a name?
answers.answer: Click any Lord, Captain or racer in the Realm tab: a card opens with Whisper, Invite and Who. Any soldier can reach another guild's Lord in two clicks.
answers.in_game: Click a Lord or Captain in the Realm tab for Whisper, Invite and Who.

questions: How do I get help from a moderator?
What's /oly helpme?
answers.answer: Type /oly helpme and your question, or click Ask a High Councillor on the Realm tab. It whispers up to three High Councillors online who take requests.
answers.in_game: Type /oly helpme and your question: it whispers up to three High Councillors online.

questions: What's the pinned line?
How do I pin a message?
answers.answer: The King, his Stewards and Hands can pin one short line for the whole army for 2 hours, and a guild master one for his own guild. /oly pin <text> pins it; /oly pin off or a click on it takes it down.
answers.in_game: Leaders pin one line for 2 hours: /oly pin <text>. /oly pin off or a click takes it down.

questions: Why is there a grey 'Public channel' line?
Can outsiders read our stuff?
answers.answer: Your guild has no channel key, so anyone who joins the channel by name could read it. An officer types /oly key <secret> with the same secret the other Olympus guilds use, and guildmates get it automatically.
answers.in_game: No channel key yet, so outsiders could read it. An officer types /oly key <secret> (same as the other guilds) and guildmates get it.

questions: How do I find a group?
What's the Board?
What's the King's week?
answers.answer: /oly lfg opens the Board: raise a Dungeon, Raid, PvP or Layer flag with a short note, and click someone's card to whisper them. It also has the King's week with signups, and camps so the army shares one fire per zone.
answers.in_game: Type /oly lfg for the Board: raise a flag (Dungeon, Raid, PvP, Layer) and click cards to whisper. It has the King's week and camps too.

questions: How do I sign up for the King's raid?
Does signing up invite me?
answers.answer: Open an entry of the King's week on the Board and press Sign up, then pick your role. It goes to whoever set the event; nobody gets invited automatically. You get a reminder 5 minutes before.
answers.in_game: Board, King's week, Sign up, pick a role. It tells the organizer; invites are by hand. You get a reminder 5 min before.

questions: What are loot notes?
Can the addon track loot points?
answers.answer: Your guild's loot decisions, kept: officers write who got what and why, and can set points by hand. Every member reads it in the Realm tab or /oly loot. It's a notebook, not a bid window.
answers.in_game: Type /oly loot: officers note who got what and why, with optional points. Everyone reads it. Not a bid window.

questions: How do I find a crafter?
How do I list my professions?
answers.answer: Type /oly craft and shift-click an item (or type its name): crafters who know it answer, and a click whispers one. Open a profession and say yes to be listed; /oly crafter off takes you off.
answers.in_game: Type /oly craft then shift-click an item: crafters who know it answer. Open a profession and say yes to get listed.

questions: Where's the Olympus chat?
How do I open the Chat tab?
answers.answer: Open the Olympus window's Chat tab, or type /ol, /olc or /oll with nothing after it (Shift-click on the minimap button works too). Every line shows whole, with search, and a box at the bottom: Enter sends, Tab changes channel.
answers.in_game: Type /ol alone (or Shift-click the minimap button) for the Chat tab. Enter sends, Tab changes channel.
answers.notes: The Chat tab is a direct top-level destination; the duplicate Realm shortcut was removed in 1.1.4.

questions: How do I mute an Olympus channel?
How do I move Olympus chat to another window?
answers.answer: Click the gear on the Chat tab: chats on or off, mute a channel in your game chat, choose the chat window each channel prints in, or add an Olympus tab. /oly mute and /oly chatwindow do the same.
answers.in_game: Gear on the Chat tab: mute a channel, pick its chat window, or add an Olympus tab. /oly mute works too.

questions: How do I get Olympus chat in its own tab?
My Olympus tab stopped getting the channels
answers.answer: Click Add an Olympus tab on the Chat tab (or type /oly chatwindow tab), then right-click General, Create New Window, and name it Olympus: the channels move there. Untick other chats in that tab's settings. The beta forgets that choice at login, so redo it after a relog.
answers.in_game: Type /oly chatwindow tab, then right-click General, Create New Window, name it Olympus: the channels move there. On the beta, redo it after a relog.
answers.notes: The channels move only after the click or /oly chatwindow tab (ns.db.chatWindows), and the beta forgets that at login. Olympus can't make the window itself: an addon doing it taints the chat box and blocks /cast and /target.

questions: I use Chattynator, how do I get the Olympus chats in a tab?
My Chattynator tab doesn't show the Olympus chats
Does Olympus work with Chattynator?
answers.answer: Type /oly chatwindow tab: it says how to make a Chattynator tab named Olympus (the + after its tabs, then Rename tab), and the channels go there once it exists. Tick Olympus under Addons in that tab's Tab Settings, or it stays empty. /oly chatwindow <name> picks another tab.
answers.in_game: With Chattynator: type /oly chatwindow tab, make a tab named Olympus (the + after its tabs), then tick Olympus under Addons in its Tab Settings.
answers.notes: Olympus only reads Chattynator's tab names and prints through its public API (GetWindowsAndTabs, AddMessageToWindowAndTab): it never makes, renames or sets up a tab, and it cannot see a tab's Addons filter, so the main window says how each time a Chattynator tab is chosen. Tabs are picked by name, not by number. Without Chattynator nothing changes.

questions: How do I talk in Olympus chat?
Who can read [Captains]?
Is Olympus chat private?
answers.answer: /ol for [Olympus] (everyone), /olc for [Captains] (Captains and up), /oll for [Lords]. The chats stay off until you say yes (/oly chat on). They aren't private: anyone on the channel can read all three, so never share passwords.
answers.in_game: Talk with /ol, /olc and /oll. /oly chat on turns chats on. Not private: never share passwords there.

questions: How do I turn off the /ol spam?
Can I hide Olympus chat?
answers.answer: /oly chat off turns the chats off on your client: nothing shows or sends. Or /oly mute olympus to hide just that channel, or /oly filter add <word> to hide lines with a word.
answers.in_game: Type /oly chat off to turn chats off. /oly mute olympus hides one channel. /oly filter add <word> hides lines with a word.

questions: How do I hide certain words?
What does /oly filter do?
answers.answer: /oly filter add <word> hides addon lines with that word on your screen only: chats, writs, decrees and Vox. The sender isn't blocked. Moderators also keep a shared list; /oly filter shared off ignores it.
answers.in_game: Type /oly filter add <word> to hide lines with it, on your screen only. /oly filter shared off ignores the moderators' list.

questions: What's a Call to arms?
How do I send a muster?
answers.answer: Captains and up send a Call to arms (an alarm and map marker for every guild) or a Muster (a rally point for 30 minutes). Royal decrees and Tabard inspections are for the Crown. Others get a local preview; /oly arms test tries it.
answers.in_game: Captains+: Call to arms (/oly arms) or Muster (/oly muster). Add test for a preview only you see.

questions: How do I turn off the alert sounds?
Why didn't I get the raid warning in my dungeon?
answers.answer: /oly sound off silences them all, or /oly sound vox off (or another kind) for one. In an instance or while Busy, alerts wait until you're out; /oly alerts always shows them at once.
answers.in_game: Type /oly sound off for all, or /oly sound <kind> off. In instances alerts wait; /oly alerts always shows them at once.

questions: What's a Royal Writ?
How do I answer a writ?
answers.answer: A letter from the King in the Decrees tab, to the Lords, to Lords and Captains, or to the whole army. Lords and Captains can answer As you command, and the King sees how many did.
answers.in_game: A letter from the King in the Decrees tab. Lords and Captains can answer As you command.

questions: Someone's lines disappeared
What's net-off?
Can moderators hide spammers?
answers.answer: Moderators (the King, his Steward, his Hands and the High Council) can hide a character or take a guild off the network for everyone. The Decrees tab lists who's hidden, why, by whom and when.
answers.in_game: Moderators can hide a character or guild from the network. The Decrees tab says who, why, by whom and when.

questions: Who opened the gates?
What's /oly log?
answers.answer: What this client saw: decrees, gates, pardons and the King's switches, each with who did it. It's on the Decrees tab or /oly log, kept on your computer only and never sent.
answers.in_game: Type /oly log: decrees, gates and pardons your client saw, with who did them. Kept on your PC only.

questions: How does the tabard patrol work?
What's /oly mark?
answers.answer: Start a patrol on the Tabards tab (or /oly patrol) and walk through the crowd: it checks nearby members level 15 and up for the Olympus tabard. /oly mark flags your target with a note. Hover anyone to see their last check.
answers.in_game: Type /oly patrol, then walk around: it checks nearby members (15+) for the tabard. /oly mark flags your target.
answers.notes: L.HELP_CMD_TABARD still says 'Heraldry Inspection tab'; the tab is Tabards.

questions: How do officers save someone's gear?
What's Gear seen?
answers.answer: Officers: target someone in range and click Inspect gear on the Tabards tab (or /oly gear). What they wear is kept under Gear seen, to check later. Nothing is scored or sent.
answers.in_game: Officers: target someone, /oly gear. It keeps what they wear under Gear seen. Nothing is scored or sent.

questions: Can officers share patrol findings?
What's /oly patrolshare?
answers.answer: If you say yes. /oly patrolshare on sends what your patrols find to your guild's officers over guild chat only, and shows you theirs for a day. /oly patrolshare off stops it.
answers.in_game: Officers: /oly patrolshare on shares your patrol findings with your guild's officers. Off stops it.

questions: What's the untabarded list?
What's a Royal Pardon?
answers.answer: Players the King's Royal Inspection caught without the colors; only the King sees it unless he chooses to show it. A Royal Pardon takes a name off for a week. Players under 15 are never listed.
answers.in_game: The King's list of players caught without the tabard. Only he sees it unless he shows it. A Pardon clears a name for a week.
answers.notes: L.PARDON_TIP still says 'Wall of Shame', the old name.

questions: What can the King do in the addon?
What's the Throne tab?
answers.answer: The King's own tab: his Agenda and week, Hold Court and key rotation. His other tools sit where they belong: Summon the Lords and the gates on the Realm tab, the Royal Inspection on Tabards, writs in Decrees. His Steward and Hands can use some of them.
answers.in_game: The King's tab: Agenda, Court, key rotation. Summon the Lords and gates are on the Realm tab, the inspection on Tabards. His Steward and Hands get some tools.

questions: I got a popup about a royal event
What's the King's Agenda?
answers.answer: The King sets the next royal event: everyone gets a popup with what, when and where, sees it on the Census, and gets reminders 10 minutes and 1 minute before.
answers.in_game: The King's Agenda: a popup with the next royal event, shown on the Census, with reminders 10 and 1 min before.

questions: I got 'The King summons his Lords'
What's Summon the Lords?
answers.answer: A roll call for Lords and Captains online: answer Present or Busy. The King sees who answered and who didn't, and the Realm tab marks each of them for a while.
answers.in_game: A roll call for Lords and Captains: answer Present or Busy. The King sees who answered.

questions: What's Hold Court?
How do I ask the King for an audience?
answers.answer: When the King opens court, everyone in his zone gets a line on the Census and Realm tabs. One click asks for an audience, and he calls players from his queue.
answers.in_game: When the King holds court, players in his zone get a line: one click asks for an audience.

questions: What's the Royal Inspection?
Why am I patrolling for the King?
answers.answer: The King calls a tabard check: a raid warning, then a sample of players who said yes patrol the tabards around them for 2 minutes and report to him. At most once every 30 minutes. /oly inspection off opts you out.
answers.in_game: A tabard check for the King: players who said yes patrol for 2 min and report. /oly inspection off opts out.
answers.notes: L.THRONE_INSPECT_TIP says 'every soldier' and 'once every 10 minutes'; the code is a sample of opted-in players and King.INSPECT_GAP = 1800.

questions: What's the King's Steward?
Who are the Hands of the King?
answers.answer: The Steward acts for the King: he names Hands, manages the treasury's keepers and uses most of the King's tools (not court, writs, pardons or his crown). Hands are players the King or Steward names to run the roll call, Agenda, Vox, inspection and gates in his name.
answers.in_game: The Steward acts for the King. Hands are players named to run his Agenda, Vox, roll call and gates.

questions: What's Vox Populi?
How do I vote?
answers.answer: The King's polls: 2 to 6 answers, open for a short time. A window pops up with check boxes and a countdown; your vote goes to the King, and everyone sees the result. /oly vox off keeps questions in chat.
answers.in_game: The King's polls: tick your answer before the timer ends. /oly vox off keeps them in chat.

questions: What's the Treasury tab?
How is the treasury balance counted?
answers.answer: The army's treasury, from its keepers' books: gold and items given to a keeper by trade or mail are donations. Keepers, the King and his Steward see it all; everyone else sees what the King chooses to show.
answers.in_game: The treasury from its keepers' books: gifts by trade or mail count. Everyone sees what the King chooses to show.

questions: Can I see the Olympus guild bank?
What's in <Olympus>'s bank?
answers.answer: When the King shows the treasury's book, the Treasury tab has a snapshot of <Olympus>'s guild bank, with search and what's gone since the last snapshot. It's a picture: nothing gets moved.
answers.in_game: When the King shows it, the Treasury tab has a snapshot of <Olympus>'s bank, with search.

questions: How do I ask the treasury for items?
What's /oly need?
answers.answer: Lords and Captains: /oly need 10 and shift-click the item. The keepers see it on their Treasury tab and mark it done or declined, and you're told. The handover is still a normal trade or mail.
answers.in_game: Lords and Captains: /oly need 10 then shift-click the item. Keepers see it and you're told when it's done.

questions: Can the King see our guild bank?
What's /oly bank share?
answers.answer: Only if your guild master or an officer says yes. /oly bank share on shows your bank's snapshot to the King, his Steward and his Hands, by whisper, never on the channel. /oly bank share off takes it back.
answers.in_game: Only with a yes: /oly bank share on shows your bank snapshot to the King's side by whisper. Off takes it back.

questions: How do I know where to donate?
What's 'taking donations'?
answers.answer: When a keeper types /oly donations on, everyone sees a line on the Realm and Treasury tabs saying he's taking donations, with his zone if he shares it. It goes off when he logs out.
answers.in_game: When a keeper takes donations, a line on the Realm and Treasury tabs says who and where.
answers.notes: Also covers the Realm tab's donations line (inventory #30).

questions: What are the dues?
How do I pay the dues?
answers.answer: One fixed weekly amount for everyone, set by the King, sent to the Treasurer. Open your mailbox (Send Mail) or a trade with him, then click Send this week's dues on the Treasury tab: it fills everything in for you to confirm. Nothing is locked behind paying.
answers.in_game: Open mail or a trade with the Treasurer, then click Send this week's dues on the Treasury tab. Nothing is locked behind paying.
answers.notes: The button shows for members on the Treasurer's realms.

questions: My settings reset, can I save them?
What's /oly backup?
answers.answer: /oly backup copies your settings (and a keeper's treasury book) as text: keep it in a file. When the beta wipes addon data, /oly restore pastes it back. Nothing is uploaded, and it never holds the channel key.
answers.in_game: Type /oly backup to copy your settings as text. Keep it; /oly restore brings it back after a wipe.

questions: How do I see the army on the map?
How do I turn off the map circles?
answers.answer: The world map shows soldiers per zone and continent, decree icons, the King's crown and camps. The round Olympus button at the bottom left of the map turns them on or off; /oly map too. In gamepad mode only continent totals show.
answers.in_game: The map shows soldiers per zone. The round Olympus button (bottom left of the map) or /oly map turns it on or off.

questions: How do I see guildmates on the map?
How do I share my position with my guild?
answers.answer: Off by default. /oly share shares your position with your guild, and /oly mates shows guildmates' dots on your map and minimap. It stays inside your guild.
answers.in_game: Type /oly share to share your spot with your guild; /oly mates shows guildmates on your map.

questions: What are the gold wings on portraits?
What's the star on nameplates?
How do I turn them off?
answers.answer: Elite borders on your target, focus and portrait: gold wings for the King, silver for the High Council, bronze for guild masters, plain bronze for those they name. Nameplates and the game's chat show the same marks, a star for other members. /oly borders, nameplates or chatmarks off hides them.
answers.in_game: Borders and marks: the King gold, the High Council silver, guild masters and those they name bronze, other members a star (not in guild chat). /oly borders, nameplates or chatmarks off hides them.
answers.notes: The README's Commands table, and the Channels section's Marks in the game's own chat (1.1.5).

questions: How do I link my alts?
Why does my alt count twice?
answers.answer: /oly alt add Name on your main, then log that alt and say yes, and the census and treasury count you once. Heads up: the beta forgets addon data at login, so right now the offer can't reach the alt.
answers.in_game: Type /oly alt add Name on your main, then say yes on the alt. On the beta the offer can't reach the alt yet.

questions: What are the commands?
How do I use this addon?
Where's the help?
answers.answer: Click the help button left of the window's X: what each tab is for, privacy switches, links and Report a bug. /oly help lists every command, and /oly status shows what your addon knows.
answers.in_game: Help button left of the X, or /oly help for all commands. /oly status shows diagnostics.
answers.notes: L.HELP_TAB_DECREES leaves out writs, net-off, sounds and the log.

questions: Can I search the lists?
How do I find a name on a tab?
answers.answer: The Census, Realm, Tabards, Treasury, Decrees and Chat tabs have a search box: guilds, Lords, players or zones on the Census, members on the Realm, players on Tabards, donors and bank items on the Treasury, the log on Decrees, lines on Chat. It only filters what you see.
answers.in_game: Most tabs have a search box on top. It only filters what you see.

questions: How do I open Olympus?
Where's the window?
answers.answer: Type /oly, click the minimap button, or the round button in your guild window. Shift-click the minimap button for the Chat tab; right-click it to show or hide the map markers.
answers.in_game: Type /oly, or click the minimap button or the round button in your guild window.

questions: Does it work with a controller?
The game froze in gamepad mode
answers.answer: Yes. With Blizzard's gamepad UI, Olympus asks in its own windows (answer with the cursor) and leaves the world map alone. If the game blocks something, /reload clears it; report it from the help button, not /oly bug.
answers.in_game: With the gamepad UI Olympus uses its own windows. If the game blocks something, /reload, then report it from the help button.

questions: Is it in Portuguese or Spanish?
How do I change the language?
answers.answer: It follows your game language. English and Portuguese are complete; Spanish, French and German cover the main screens. The pages' ? help and the Answers are in English for now. Only what's on your screen changes.
answers.in_game: It follows your game language: English and Portuguese in full, Spanish, French and German for the main screens. Page help is in English.

questions: How do I seal the channel?
How do I ignore someone in Olympus?
answers.answer: Officers: /oly key <secret> seals the Olympus channel so outsiders can't join. Use the same secret as the other Olympus guilds or your guild splits off. /oly block <name> ignores everything a player sends.
answers.in_game: Officers: /oly key <secret> (same as other guilds) seals the channel. /oly block <name> ignores a player.

questions: How do I get my Discord role?
What's /oly discord?
answers.answer: Olympus Link will prove your character to the Olympus bot on Discord for your role, but it isn't open yet: it needs a later addon update. Until then /oly discord just says it's not open.
answers.in_game: Olympus Link (Discord roles) isn't open yet: it comes with a later update of the addon.

questions: How do I hide Blizzard's Issue Reporter box?
What's that Issue Reporter window at login?
answers.answer: Click Hide on the box, or type /oly issuereporter hide; /oly issuereporter show brings it back. The beta forgets addon settings at login, so you may have to hide it again after a relog. With the gamepad UI Olympus leaves it alone.
answers.in_game: Click Hide on the box or /oly issuereporter hide. The beta forgets it at login, so redo it after a relog.
answers.notes: The box only exists on beta and PTR clients.

questions: What's OlympusBridge?
Can other addons read Olympus?
answers.answer: A read-only door for the moderators' companion addon: it can ask whether a name is a High Councillor and read chat lines your addon already accepted. It sends and changes nothing in Olympus.
answers.in_game: A read-only door for the moderators' companion addon. It sends and changes nothing.

questions: What's the Workshop tab?
Why did I get a roll call?
answers.answer: The author's own tab: roll calls for versions and errors, asking out-of-date players to update, and bug reports players send him. Only he has it. You answer roll calls only if you said yes; /oly rollcall off stops them.
answers.in_game: The author's tab for versions and bug reports. You answer roll calls only if you said yes; /oly rollcall off stops them.

questions: What does the ? on a page do?
Where's the explanation of this page?
answers.answer: Each page has a ? in its bottom box: it explains that page and, where it shows counts, why they can differ between players. The Chat tab has no bottom box, so no ? of its own. The help button left of the X is the general help.
answers.in_game: The ? in each page's bottom box explains that page and why its counts can differ. The Chat tab has none: the help button left of the X covers it.
answers.notes: 1.1.5: the Chat tab's own ? by the gear is gone (it doubled the window's help button).

questions: What's the Answers button?
How do moderators answer questions so fast?
answers.answer: The author, the High Council and the Stewards get an Answers button at the end of the Chat tab's box and in Olympus's whisper window: short ready answers by topic, searchable. A click puts one in the box to edit; nothing is sent until you do.
answers.in_game: The author, High Council and Stewards have an Answers button: a click puts a ready answer in the box to edit, nothing is sent by itself.

questions: How do I install Olympus?
Where do I get the addon?
answers.answer: Get Olympus Guild in the CurseForge app or WowUp and pick your Forever (beta) game install, not Classic Era. Then restart the game. By hand: unzip it so you end up with Interface > AddOns > Olympus > Olympus.toc.
answers.in_game: Get Olympus Guild in the CurseForge app or WowUp (pick the Forever install), then restart the game.

questions: How do I update?
I updated but nothing changed
answers.answer: Update Olympus Guild in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then close and reopen the game: a /reload won't load a new version properly. /oly status shows your version on its first line.
answers.in_game: Update in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then close and reopen the game (a /reload isn't enough).

questions: Which version do I have?
Am I up to date?
answers.answer: Type /oly status: the first line shows your version, and a later line shows the latest release your addon heard of and whether you're behind.
answers.in_game: Type /oly status: the first line is your version, and a later line says if a newer one is out.

questions: Do I have to update?
My version is old, does it matter?
answers.answer: Please do. Older versions drop what newer ones send, so your census can look off and your guild can look broken to everyone else. Update in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then restart the game.
answers.in_game: Please update: old versions drop what new ones send, and your guild can look broken to others. CurseForge or WowUp, then restart.
answers.notes: No minimum version is enforced anywhere.

questions: The AddOns list says 'out of date'
Olympus is disabled as out of date
answers.answer: That's the game comparing against its own patch number, not Olympus's version. Tick Load out of date AddOns in the AddOns list and it loads.
answers.in_game: That's the game's patch check, not Olympus. Tick Load out of date AddOns in the AddOns list.

questions: I got a window saying the author asks me to update
Is the update popup legit?
answers.answer: If it says the author of the addon asks you, it's real: only his character can send it, and only when your version is older than the one he released. Update in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then restart. /oly rollcall off stops his. One naming a player is that player's ask.
answers.in_game: If it says the author asks, it's real: only his character can send it, and only if you're behind. Update and restart. /oly rollcall off stops his.
sources: Workshop.lua:146-148,516,534-553 (V3 carries Workshop.Latest(), his running build)
answers.notes: A player's ask (1.1.2, V9) names the player; see rc-got-asked.

questions: Where do I report a bug?
How do I send the author an error?
answers.answer: Open the Olympus window, click the help button left of the X, then Report a bug. Copy the text to GitHub or a CurseForge comment. If the author is online, that window also has a button that sends it straight to him in game.
answers.in_game: Olympus window, help button (left of the X), Report a bug. If the author's online there's a button to send it to him.
answers.notes: /oly bug opens the same report. Players who send it to the author see 'got your bug report' once he has it; at most one every 10 minutes.

questions: The game says it blocked Olympus
I got an 'action blocked' error
answers.answer: A /reload clears it. Then tell us what happened: Olympus window, help button, Report a bug. With the gamepad UI, don't type /oly bug in chat; use the button, since a typed command can set the block off again.
answers.in_game: A /reload clears it. Then report it: Olympus window, help button, Report a bug (not /oly bug with the gamepad).
answers.notes: GitHub #40 ('Who List error') was ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN UpdateGuildLobby() from Blizzard_GuildControlUI, not Olympus code.

questions: My settings reset every login
Why do I keep getting asked the same questions?
answers.answer: The beta forgets addon data at login right now, so settings and your privacy answers reset each session. /oly backup saves your settings as text and /oly restore puts them back, but not your privacy answers: those get asked again.
answers.in_game: The beta forgets addon data at login. /oly backup and /oly restore bring your settings back; privacy answers are asked again each session.
sources: README.md:1713-1716,1242-1257 (a backup never holds your yeses to sharing)

questions: Is it safe? What does it send?
Does the addon send my data anywhere?
answers.answer: It talks only through the game's own addon messages, with no server of its own. Your guild's census, your addon's hello and its version (to a player's Check version) go out as is; your location, chats and the rest wait for your yes. /oly privacy shows every switch.
answers.in_game: It only uses the game's addon messages, no outside server. Location, chats and the rest wait for your yes (/oly privacy).
answers.notes: Exception: Olympus Link (not open yet) uses a web page and the Discord bot, only when a player chooses to link.

questions: Can NA and EU be linked?
Why can't I see the EU guilds?
answers.answer: No, they're separate game worlds, and the addon only talks inside the game. Each region has its own census.
answers.in_game: No: NA and EU are separate game worlds, so each has its own census.

questions: Does it work on Classic Era or Anniversary?
Which game versions does Olympus support?
answers.answer: It's built for WoW: Forever, and also tested on Classic Era and TBC Anniversary. Pick the right game install in the CurseForge app.
answers.in_game: Built for WoW: Forever, also tested on Classic Era and Anniversary.

questions: How do I see someone's Olympus version?
Is my guildmate on the latest version?
answers.answer: Right-click the player (their name in chat, the guild roster or their portrait): the Olympus line shows their addon version and whether it's up to date. Guildmates show by themselves; for anyone else pick Check version and their addon answers in seconds.
answers.in_game: Right-click them: the Olympus line shows their version. Not seen yet? Pick Check version and their addon answers in a few seconds.
answers.notes: Guildmates' versions come from their hello (every 60 s, or every 10 min for quiet members). Check version is one addon whisper (V7) that the other addon answers (V8).

questions: Why can't I see the version of someone in another guild?
It says not seen for a player from another guild
answers.answer: Your addon only hears your own guild's versions by itself. For anyone else, right-click them and pick Check version: their addon answers with its version. Only 1.1.2 and newer answer, so no answer can mean no Olympus, an older one, a dungeon or raid, or no Olympus guild.
answers.in_game: Your addon only hears your own guild by itself. Right-click them and pick Check version; only 1.1.2 and newer answer, so no answer can mean an older one.
answers.notes: Only players in an Olympus guild answer: outside one the addon sends nothing. The author's Check version is his roll call to that player alone (every version since 0.9.9 answers it, after the player's yes).

questions: How do I ask someone to update?
Can I tell a guildmate their addon is old?
answers.answer: Right-click them and pick Ask to update (it only shows when they're behind). On 1.1.2 or newer their addon shows a small notice with where to update; older ones can't, so it opens a whisper with the ask for you to send. One ask per player a day, 5 an hour.
answers.in_game: Right-click them, Ask to update (it shows when they're behind). 1.1.2+ get a small notice; for older ones it opens a whisper you send.
answers.notes: The author's pick sends his usual update window (V3), which every version shows, naming the version he marked as released. Anyone else's sends V9, shown once a day at most, 7 days of quiet after Don't remind me. On the beta the limits last until logout (addon data isn't loaded back).

questions: A window says someone asks me to update Olympus
A player asked me to update, is that legit?
answers.answer: A player saw your Olympus is older than the one they know (the window names them; the author's own says it's the author). Update in the CurseForge app or WowUp, then restart the game. Don't remind me hides these asks for 7 days (on the beta, until you log out).
answers.in_game: A player saw your Olympus is older. Update in CurseForge or WowUp and restart; Don't remind me hides these for 7 days (on the beta until you log out).
answers.notes: Only the author's ask opens the official update window; see help-author-update-popup. Never from a player you block, ignore or the moderators took off, and never naming a version the author hasn't released.

questions: Does right-clicking send anything?
Can people see when I check their version?
answers.answer: Opening the menu sends nothing. Check version sends one tiny addon message that their addon answers with its version, nothing else. Ask to update sends one notice (or opens a whisper for an old version). Tell them about Olympus only opens a whisper you send yourself.
answers.in_game: Opening the menu sends nothing. Check version sends one tiny addon message; Tell them about Olympus opens a whisper you send yourself.

questions: Why is there no Olympus line when I right-click someone?
The version check is missing from the menu
answers.answer: It shows on players you can reach, while you're in an Olympus guild: not on yourself, enemies, offline names or Battle.net friends. In a dungeon or raid its buttons are greyed. Game clients without the new right-click menus don't get it at all.
answers.in_game: It only shows where it can help: not on yourself, enemies, offline names or Battle.net friends, and only while you're in an Olympus guild.
answers.notes: Hooked menus: PLAYER, PARTY, RAID_PLAYER, RAID, FRIEND, COMMUNITIES_GUILD_MEMBER, COMMUNITIES_WOW_MEMBER, GUILD, CHAT_ROSTER, RECENT_ALLY (Menu.ModifyMenu).

questions: The author asked for my bug report, what do I do?
What's the 'send your bug report' window?
answers.answer: The author asks for it when he's looking into a problem. See what is sent shows the exact text (errors and diagnostics, the same as /oly bug). Send and it goes to him alone, in game; Not now sends nothing.
answers.in_game: The author asked for your bug report. See what is sent shows it; Send goes to him alone, Not now sends nothing.
answers.notes: Only a request from the author's character opens it (VR); anyone else's is ignored.

questions: How do I get someone to install Olympus?
What's Tell them about Olympus?
answers.answer: Right-click them: when their addon didn't answer Check version, pick Tell them about Olympus. A whisper with the CurseForge link opens (to get it, or update an old one) for you to edit, and nothing goes out until you press Send.
answers.in_game: Right-click them, Check version, then Tell them about Olympus: a whisper with the link opens, and you send it yourself.
